hook.name: HOODDOGFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based dynamic fee hook for HOODDOG launchpad pools on Uniswap v4. Charges ETH fees (1%–5%) on buy swaps via beforeSwap return delta and on sell swaps via afterSwap return delta, with the rate scaling based on the previous swap's tick movement. Only exact-input swaps are permitted; exact-output swaps revert.
